title: Trade Conflicts and Long-Term Consequences: Are Soybeans Doomed to Repeat History?
notes: University extension analysis. US embargo on soybean and cottonseed exports June 1973, contracts reinstated by 1 October 1973; Japan then imported 97% of its soybeans, 90% from the US; Japan created JICA in 1974 and invested in Brazil's Cerrado (PRODECER, about 20 years); the European Community began oilseed subsidies. US produced about 70% of world soybeans in 1973; US and Brazil over 80% of world exports in 2024.
